41bec1a5-4022-4c23-a43a-5ea100dcf591.name: Create
41bec1a5-4022-4c23-a43a-5ea100dcf591.note:
- To create a quality report with empty checks (able to accept an array of payloads)
- Takes in a qualitySpecificationGroupId (for the list of specifications) and a qualitySubjectListId (for the sampleSize of the report)
- Either a productionRunId or an InventoryId is required to be tied to the report
- Optionally, a workOrderId and workOrderProcess may be provided to tie to the report

67405e6d-a12f-4872-8ce6-5b52752fe4ba.name: Route
67405e6d-a12f-4872-8ce6-5b52752fe4ba.note: Currently the CREATE_FOR and CREATE_AND_COMPLETE routes are not used

aee10c07-3a69-4e95-971d-96e159564f72.name: CreateAndComplete
aee10c07-3a69-4e95-971d-96e159564f72.note:
- To create a quality report with values filled in for quality checks (able to accept an array of payloads)
- The values object should have keys with the name matching the qualitySpefication and values (for multiple samples an array of values) for the quality check to be added to the report and validated.
- Takes in a qualitySpecificationGroupId (for the list of specifications) and a qualitySubjectListId (for the sampleSize of the report)
- A productionRunId is optional
- At least one inventoryId is required to be tied to the report (accepts an array)
- Optionally, a workOrderId and workOrderProcess may be provided to tie to the report
- Inventory verification will take place at the end of this route; if insufficient inventory is tied to the report, the report status will be marked as "Missing Inventory" (which can be updated/refreshed from the Quality Checks Screen/tab)
- If any check fails, all inventory tied to the production run (or Quality Report for On-Transaction intervals) will be placed in the QC (Hold) status.

69503032-b000-4731-bc90-fc60b05b894c.name: CreateFor
69503032-b000-4731-bc90-fc60b05b894c.note:
- Searches all of the Quality Subject List based the qualitySubjectListCombinations saved transform
- Create Quality Reports for Every Quality Specification Group linked to all the found Quality Subject List (uses the sampleSize from the relevant subject list)
- Either a productionRunId or an InventoryId is required to be tied to the report
- Optionally, a workOrderId and workOrderProcess may be provided to tie to the report

6c731592-aa3b-493a-a20c-95c6774e0774.name: Update
6c731592-aa3b-493a-a20c-95c6774e0774.note:
- To add quality checks to a single quality report. Takes a reportId and values. Can also be run with just the reportId to refresh the inventory status of the report
- If all checks are completed, the report is marked complete.
- If checks pass/fail the report is marked with the pass/fail status.
- If any check fails, all inventory tied to the production run (or Quality Report for On-Transaction intervals) will be placed in the QC (Hold) status.
- This action is called from the Quality Checks screen/tab

8643ef1d-2592-480a-b9f4-7704d48de636.name: Query quality specifications and inventory quantity

614a25f9-eed8-425f-aae4-a0bf2305779a.name: Create (and complete) quality report/checks
614a25f9-eed8-425f-aae4-a0bf2305779a.note: Checks the quality of provided values against specifications, and creates quality checks and report (pass/fail) based on all of the quality checks

855b2632-e6ac-4b1a-9148-a1a2227b3786.name: Check if quality report is not complete

f5c78fe6-c6a7-4c49-99dd-38bb4e453b70.name: Check if any intervals have a frequency
f5c78fe6-c6a7-4c49-99dd-38bb4e453b70.note: Also check to make sure that all frequencies are valid (at least 1 minute)

e6237457-da7d-4044-be79-b3112da748cf.name: DIST_LOAD
e6237457-da7d-4044-be79-b3112da748cf.note: When a work order is dispatched, the Dispatch Functions flow will call the Quality Functions flow (with an action of DIST_LOAD) - entries in the junction table ProductionSetupQualitySubjectList will be created (to be used by either manual report generation, or automated report generation by the Production Run functions flow calling the Quality Functions flow)

c2186dcd-275d-4ee1-a64e-1dec9b9e7e28.name: DIST_UNLOAD
c2186dcd-275d-4ee1-a64e-1dec9b9e7e28.note: When a work order distribution is unloaded, the Dispatch Functions flow will call the Quality Functions Flow (DIST_UNLOAD action) to delete entries from the junction table ProductionSetupQualitySubjectLists (to account for future changes to Quality Subject List definitions)

d0f4a87e-33c0-42da-a149-6e8553ee2c7c.name: Schedule
d0f4a87e-33c0-42da-a149-6e8553ee2c7c.note:
Schedule uses the create route and is deleted after running if the subject list quality interval is "repeat = false"

(not currently used)

d94d311a-6257-4701-95c7-0b54752b4982.name: RUN_START
d94d311a-6257-4701-95c7-0b54752b4982.note: When a Production Run is started, the Production Run functions flow will query the applicable intervals, and will call the Quality Functions flow (RUN_START action) to trigger Pre-Process reports.

b05344e5-ef45-4ca6-be69-df697e33255a.name: RUN_STOP
b05344e5-ef45-4ca6-be69-df697e33255a.note: When a Production Run is stopped, the Production Run functions flow will again query the applicable intervals, and call the Quality Functions flow (RUN_END action) for generation of Post-Process Reports

a9c08153-28cf-4231-b328-3fcd89d42ecd.name: Schedule doesn't repeat?
a9c08153-28cf-4231-b328-3fcd89d42ecd.note: If this is a scheduled quality report, delete the schedule if the interval is not "repeat"

fbc63ce5-efa2-4f2d-9c4a-77db98c107f1.name: REPORT_ON_QUANTITY
fbc63ce5-efa2-4f2d-9c4a-77db98c107f1.note: This action is called every time the production run is updated (if a ProductionSetupQualitySubjectList with a quantity interval applies to the production run). Reports will be generated based on the quantity of parts produced, taking into account previous reports already generated based on quantity, and if a multiple of the quantity is produced, multiple reports will be generated. This action uses the CREATE route internally to facilitate the creation of Quality Reports.

08aabad8-3e0d-44b6-b116-fb6af78f9f46.name: Data Changes (Inventory Transaction)
08aabad8-3e0d-44b6-b116-fb6af78f9f46.note:
If the transactionType matches any defined On-Transaction interval

Checks if it is a ProductionAdd transaction type, if so creates a report based on the ProductionSetupQualitySubject list with the productionRunId tied to the report

If not a ProductionAdd transaction type, creates a report based on the transaction (only productId subject lists applicable), if the transaction type matches

1c2bf278-a71f-4d2d-b0bc-4f8bd78b03a8.name: Query intervals
1c2bf278-a71f-4d2d-b0bc-4f8bd78b03a8.note: Query quality intervals for data change transaction type to prevent uncessecary node execution.

b95ea4d3-0c86-4a8c-9011-163c4f71876b.name: Accept (transaction type)
b95ea4d3-0c86-4a8c-9011-163c4f71876b.note: Only execute remainder of flow if data change transaction type is found in the list of intervals

1c477c7f-9dff-442f-abd4-1420823f3a3f.name: Data Change Source (ProductionAdd)
1c477c7f-9dff-442f-abd4-1420823f3a3f.note: Data change source for (on transaction) intervals

acf25036-3c16-4b65-92f9-7ca2f7e1526e.name: JSONata: Merge subjects
acf25036-3c16-4b65-92f9-7ca2f7e1526e.note: Merge the list of subjects to be included on the quality report

cd227be6-1511-4f05-814d-faee4be9cf46.name: REPORT_ON_DEMAND
cd227be6-1511-4f05-814d-faee4be9cf46.note: This action is called when clicking the "New Quality Report" button from the DMO v2 Control Panel, and will create Quality Reports for a specification group so long as there is a subject list with no interval assigned to it. This action also uses the CREATE route internally to facilitate the creation of Quality Reports

069020a0-9d36-4ce8-82b6-e65ffddf049c.name: Data Change Source (InventoryAdjustment)
069020a0-9d36-4ce8-82b6-e65ffddf049c.note: Data change source for (on transaction) intervals

94953107-648e-44d8-88ba-78e7abef2981.name: Insufficient inventory?
94953107-648e-44d8-88ba-78e7abef2981.note: Inventory on report must be at least the sampleSize
